dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Gambino was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on his behavior in a home environment. Gambino has shown highly fearful behavior while at the care center, and has been avoidant of handlers, tensing and backing away when approached, and balking on leash when being returned to kennel. In calmer setting and with familiar handlers, he has shown social and affiliative behavior, but due to his fearfulness we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Gambino
